summary: This Form 6-K filed by YXT.com Group Holding Ltd announces a change in its ADS ratio from 1 ADS representing 3 ordinary shares to 1 ADS representing 30 ordinary shares, effective July 14, 2026. This is a reverse ADS split equivalent to 1-for-10, with no change to underlying ordinary shares. No cash consideration, premium, or tender is involved. The depositary bank will handle the automatic exchange, and fractional entitlements will be sold for cash. This is a routine corporate action to adjust trading price, not a special situation.
